sections.Profile:
Zodiac and Planets are twin electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Williams Electronic Games in 1971, designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Louis Raynaud. Both games share the same core design, with Zodiac being a replay model and Planets configured for New York markets without a replay feature.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Dual Theme, Multi Theme, Original Theme, Astrology, 1970s, Playfield Gimmick, Widebody
